(Where's Talossa??)

OK, people, before this goes any further: some of the cultures above are fictional ("micronations"), made-up countries that people get into primarily for the fun of play-acting at politics. [http://www.talossa.com alossa] is a quite well-known instance, which also features a conlang (Proven�al meets Albanian and Berber for lunch) whose primary purpose is to use as many diacritics as possible :-) . For El Grotto, see tsali's home page. For Livagian, see [http://wiw.org/~jkominek/lojban/9504/msg00006.html] .

In checking whether Livagian was mentioned elsewhere online, btw, I fell upon the Conlang Ethnologue ([http://members.tripod.com/microtonal/language/conlang/ethnologueam.html -m], [http://members.tripod.com/microtonal/language/conlang/ethnologueny.html -z]) : a picture-perfect parody of [http://www.ethnologue.com he SIL Ethnologue]!
